{{Quote|Changing your looks won't help much. Even with a wig or facial prosthetics you tend to stand out in a crowd.|Groshik to Dessel|<ref name="POD">''[[Darth Bane: Path of Destruction]]''</ref>}}
A '''wig''' was a covering of the head made to resemble natural [[Hair/Legends|hair]]. It was worn by people trying to conceal their baldness or as a disguise&mdash;as exemplified by the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Attuma Duum]]<ref name="DHSJ">''[[The Clone Wars: Deadly Hands of Shon-Ju]]''</ref>. Sometimes, elaborate wigs were used a symbol of high status, notably amongst the [[Tof/Legends|Tof]] from the [[Firefist]] satellite [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].<ref name="SW107">[[Star Wars (1977) 107|''Star Wars'' (1977) 107]]</ref> Some [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] had the quirk to use live [[Sha'rellian toop/Legends|sha'rellian toops]] as wigs.<ref name="Evil Plans">{{TCW|Evil Plans}}</ref>

When [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] was still a young [[Prince/Legends|princess]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], she was once forced to wear a wig after she deliberately cut her hair. Madame [[Vesta]], headmistress of [[Alderaan Select Academy for Young Ladies]], used to think it was improper for a princess to sport short hair.<ref name="PLD">{{Tales|11|The Princess Leia Diaries}}</ref> Years before, her mother [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] had worn a wig adorned with a [[Gold/Legends|gold]] faceframe during her [[Coronation of Queen Amidala/Legends|coronation ceremony]].<ref name="SWG5">{{Topps|set=2010 Topps Star Wars Galaxy Series 5|cardname=The New Queen's Fitting|link=https://www.beckett.com/non-sports/2010/star-wars-galaxy-series-5/2-the-new-queens-fitting-7534600}}</ref> Padmé continued to wear wigs during the Clone Wars while she was a senator as a part of some of her fancier outfits.

Due to the mimetic nature of their art, [[Actor/Legends|actors]] and singers often wore wigs to help them slip into their roles. Wigs made those artists appear a different age or condition, but they sometimes were a question of mere fashion and taste.<ref name="Ambush">''[[Ambush at Corellia]]''</ref><ref name="SW77">[[Star Wars (1977) 77|''Star Wars'' (1977) 77]]</ref>

A person of importance was sometimes known colloquially as a "bigwig."<ref name="POT">''[[Planet of Twilight]]''</ref> 

==History==
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="NEC Note">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. The scene from ''[[Jango Fett: Bounty Hunter]]'' in which [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] is in the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]] takes place immediately before the film, meaning it must be set in that [[Standard year/Legends|year]].</ref> the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|woman]] [[Di Mantid]] wore a [[Color/Legends|blonde]] Human hair wig<ref name="FF">{{FactFile|96|OUT 1-2|Outlander Nightclub Patrons}}</ref> at the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]],<ref name="Jango Fett: Bounty Hunter">''[[Jango Fett: Bounty Hunter]]''</ref> [[Nightclub/Legends|nightclub]] and [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] hall located in the [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]] of Coruscant,<ref name="CSWE2">{{CSWECite|II|431|Outlander Club}}</ref> when the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] and [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] visited.<ref name="Jango Fett: Bounty Hunter" /> Shortly after the visit, Mantid again wore the wig when she visited the club,<ref name="aotc">{{Film|II}}</ref> vying for the unofficial title of "best dressed Outlander patron" with the women [[Nyrat Agira/Legends|Nyrat Agira]] and [[Wilst Molan]]. Even though her wig was eye-catching, her look was not considered serious competition to Agira's.<ref name="FF" />
